prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE finished HOI4 Soviet leader portrait, painted reconstruction/upscale from the supplied tiny game icon. Image 1 is the authoritative IDENTITY reference: preserve this specific face, apparent age, facial proportions, hairline, hair/facial hair and expression. Images 2 and 3 are STYLE and COMPOSITION references only (Kamenev and Trotsky); do not copy their faces. Remove all icon framing, document/paper overlays, bars and UI embellishments. Extend naturally into a head-and-shoulders portrait ending at upper chest, face prominent and fully visible, centered or slightly left, facing the same direction as the small reference. Match the large samples: restrained realistic hand-painted oil/colorized photograph, muted brown grey / cool slate palette, soft upper-left key light, fine subdued brush texture, believable skin, dignified unexaggerated features. Plain warm grey-beige background matching the reference portraits, faint subtle tonal variation only; no scenery, vignette frame, symbols, writing, borders or watermark. Portrait canvas ratio exactly 156:210, e.g. 936x1260, whole crown and shoulders inside. Final use is 156x210 px so clear recognizable facial landmarks matter more than tiny detail. PNG output; uniform background may be opaque as in samples.
Subject: Grigory Sokolnikov / 格里戈里·索柯里尼柯夫. Preserve image 1's distinctive tall forehead, receding swept-back dark hair, lean tapered face, narrow moustache and small pointed chin beard. Follow image 1 exactly for facial accessories, not the style samples. Normal dark civilian suit, white shirt and discreet tie, reserved intelligent expression. No cap, no documents.
